knack: Trade goods, prices, and a shrewd bargain.
item: A ledger of debts, a few still owed to you.
complication: Old creditors and trade rivals know your face.

knack: Ailments, dressings, and steadying the hurt.
item: A roll of clean linen and a bone needle.
complication: A patient died under your care, and the kin remember.

knack: Field labor, rough shelter, and going unmissed.
item: A forged pass, the ink still too fresh.
complication: Your old lord's men still hunt an escaped serf.

knack: Ranks, camp routine, and battle signals.
item: A cashiered man's blade, the crest filed off.
complication: Old comrades blame you, or want an answer.

knack: Heraldry, court manners, and highborn address.
item: A signet your family would see you stop using.
complication: Your kin deny you, pursue you, or resent you.

knack: Spell components, reagents, and careful handling.
item: A satchel of labelled jars, two unlabelled.
complication: You cast no spells by this, and your master's debts may find you.

knack: Decks, sea commands, and keeping your feet.
item: A clasp knife and a hank of tarred cord.
complication: A short-handed crew will press your hands again.

knack: Reciting, mimicry, and a passing impression.
item: A trunk of cheap costume and one good mask.
complication: Other players recall your name, and your unpaid debts.

knack: A great house's routine, and where its stores sit.
item: A livery badge from a house you left.
complication: You are taken for a servant, or known by a former master.

knack: Ambush ground, cold camps, and a posted watch.
item: A whistle cut from bone, and a share never paid.
complication: Old partners or victims still mean to find you.

knack: Local law, customary fines, and plain questioning.
item: A tipstaff and a writ you never served.
complication: Folk take you for the reeve's man still.

knack: A craft's tools, stock, and hidden flaws.
item: A journeyman's token the guild would reclaim.
complication: The guild bars its doors to you, or wants its dues.

knack: Roads, guest customs, and wayside shrines.
item: A staff hung with tokens of far shrines.
complication: Fellow pilgrims ask you to carry word, or carry them.

knack: Hidden goods, quiet ports, and discreet contacts.
item: A coat of many pockets, two still full.
complication: The watch and old partners suspect you yet.

knack: Camp supplies, chores, and a host's signs.
item: A mended kettle and a soldier's luck-charm.
complication: Soldiers name you outsider; followers want your help.

knack: Roads, warding goods, and reading a skyline.
item: A dented helm and a spear worn smooth.
complication: A caravan you guarded was lost, and its owner blames you.

knack: Doctrine, relics, and the cracks in a faith.
item: A deconsecrated symbol you cannot quite discard.
complication: The temple that cast you out watches for heresy.

knack: Rents, boundaries, and the handling of men.
item: A deed to land that is no longer yours.
complication: Those who took your land fear your return.

knack: Letters, old tongues, and dusty lore.
item: A satchel of books the college wants back.
complication: The university named you a fraud, or a thief.

knack: Far customs, strange tongues, and distant roads.
item: Coins from a realm no one here will trade.
complication: You cannot go home, and here you are a stranger.
